description: Eight independently generated modulation sources: each trigger gives every output either a low-frequency oscillator at a random rate, waveform and phase, or a single steady random voltage.

params.text: Switches the output between -5V to +5V in the lower position and 0V to 10V in the upper one, the upper setting adding 5V to whatever was generated.
Sets how far a generated setting may stray from BIAS; at 0 every trigger gives the same rate and the same held voltage, though the waveform is chosen afresh each time.
Sets the centre that the random rate and the random held voltage are drawn around, -1 to +1; at the middle the rate is drawn around 1Hz and held voltages around 0V.
In its upper position each trigger has an even chance of producing a steady held voltage instead of an oscillator; in its lower position every trigger produces an oscillator.

inputs.text: A rising edge generates a fresh random setting for every output.

outputs.text: One of the generated modulation voltages; every output is generated separately, so one trigger sets eight unrelated shapes running.

notes: Nothing changes until a trigger reaches TRIG. VAR, BIAS and the S&H switch are read at the instant of the trigger, so turning them has no effect until the next one.
An output's oscillator only advances while that jack is patched, so an unpatched output is frozen rather than running silently.
A generated oscillator is a blend of sine, triangle, saw and square chosen at random, started at a random phase, at a random rate up to eight octaves either side of the BIAS centre.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
